title: Add login button to header for unauthenticated users

requirements.text: Add a prominent 'Login' or 'Sign In' button to the Header component that appears in the top-right corner for unauthenticated users, positioned before the theme toggle button

quotes: add a login button to the app's header/navigation
Appears in the top-right corner of the header for unauthenticated users

acceptanceCriteria: Login button is visible in the header when user is not authenticated
Button is positioned in the top-right area of the header navigation
Button has clear, prominent styling that matches the app's visual theme
Button is responsive and visible on mobile, tablet, and desktop screen sizes

requirements.text: Connect the login button to trigger Internet Identity authentication using the existing useInternetIdentity hook's login function when clicked

quotes: Triggers Internet Identity authentication when clicked

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the login button initiates the Internet Identity authentication flow
Authentication uses the existing useInternetIdentity context and login method
Button shows loading state during authentication process

requirements.text: Hide the login button and show the existing logout/profile controls in the Header component after successful authentication

quotes: Replaces itself with user profile/logout controls after successful login

acceptanceCriteria: Login button is hidden when user is authenticated
Existing logout button and user controls remain visible for authenticated users
Transition between login and authenticated states is smooth

constraints: Use the existing useInternetIdentity hook and authentication system
Maintain the current Header component structure and existing navigation elements
Preserve the existing theme toggle and logout functionality
nonGoals: Creating new authentication providers or methods beyond Internet Identity
Modifying the authentication flow or identity management logic
Adding registration or signup flows separate from Internet Identity
Implementing social login buttons (Google, Facebook, etc.)
